views.name: match_row_level
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  "id",
  "league_id",
  "season",
  "home_team_goal",
  "away_team_goal"
FROM "Match"
views.description: One row per match with raw match-level columns (no aggregation). Useful as the base cohort for seasonal, league, team, and match-based analytics.
validated_on: List the name of leagues in which the average goals by the home team is higher than the away team in the 2009/2010 season.

views.name: league_basic
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  id,
  name,
  country_id
FROM League
views.description: Canonical league rows exposing league key and name for joins and aggregations.
validated_on: Give the name of the league had the most matches end as draw in the 2016 season?
Give the name of the league with the highest matches of all time and how many matches were played in the said league.
List the name of leagues in which the average goals by the home team is higher than the away team in the 2009/2010 season.

views.name: match_goals_by_league_season
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  m.league_id AS league_id,
  m.season AS season,
  SUM(COALESCE(m.home_team_goal,0) + COALESCE(m.away_team_goal,0)) AS total_goals
FROM match_row_level m
GROUP BY
  m.league_id,
  m.season
views.description: Aggregated measure: total goals per league per season (sum of home + away goals). Reusable for any season-level league ranking.

views.name: matches_in_league_season
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  m.id AS id,
  m.match_api_id AS match_api_id,
  m.league_id AS league_id,
  m.season AS season,
  m.date AS date,
  m.home_team_api_id AS home_team_api_id,
  m.away_team_api_id AS away_team_api_id,
  m.home_team_goal AS home_team_goal,
  m.away_team_goal AS away_team_goal
FROM Match m
WHERE m.season = 'None'
  AND m.league_id = 'None'
views.description: One row per match filtered to matches that belong to a particular league and season. Exposes match identifiers, teams, scores and date for downstream aggregation.

views.name: team_identifiers
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  team_api_id,
  team_long_name,
  team_short_name,
  team_fifa_api_id,
  id
FROM Team
views.description: Canonical team identifier and display names. One row per team_api_id exposing the team's long and short names for joins and presentation.

views.name: match_away_win_flag
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  m.id AS id,
  m.away_team_api_id AS away_team_api_id,
  m.season AS season,
  m.league_id AS league_id,
  CASE
    WHEN m.away_team_goal IS NOT NULL
     AND m.home_team_goal IS NOT NULL
     AND m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS away_win
FROM Match m
views.description: A row-level flag for each match indicating whether the away team won. Keeps one row per match with an away_win boolean for easy counting per team/season/league.

views.name: team_attributes_non_null_build_up
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  id,
  team_api_id,
  team_fifa_api_id,
  date,
  buildUpPlaySpeed,
  buildUpPlaySpeedClass
FROM Team_Attributes
WHERE buildUpPlaySpeed IS NOT NULL
views.description: All Team_Attributes rows where buildUpPlaySpeed is not NULL (one row per Team_Attributes record). Keeps raw attribute measures and keys for downstream aggregation.

views.name: team_build_up_speed_agg
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  team_api_id,
  team_fifa_api_id,
  MAX(buildUpPlaySpeed) AS buildUpPlaySpeed_max,
  AVG(buildUpPlaySpeed) AS buildUpPlaySpeed_avg,
  MIN(buildUpPlaySpeed) AS buildUpPlaySpeed_min,
  COUNT(buildUpPlaySpeed) AS buildUpPlaySpeed_count
FROM Team_Attributes
WHERE buildUpPlaySpeed IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY team_api_id, team_fifa_api_id
views.description: Per-team aggregated build-up play speed measures computed from Team_Attributes (ignores NULL buildUpPlaySpeed). Produces max/min/avg and count for reuse in ranking or filtering.

views.name: matches_row_level
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  m.id AS id,
  m.match_api_id AS match_api_id,
  m.season AS season,
  m.date AS date,
  m.league_id AS league_id,
  m.home_team_api_id AS home_team_api_id,
  m.away_team_api_id AS away_team_api_id,
  m.home_team_goal AS home_team_goal,
  m.away_team_goal AS away_team_goal,
  CASE
    WHEN m.home_team_goal IS NOT NULL AND m.away_team_goal IS NOT NULL AND m.home_team_goal = m.away_team_goal THEN 1
    WHEN m.home_team_goal IS NOT NULL AND m.away_team_goal IS NOT NULL AND m.home_team_goal <> m.away_team_goal THEN 0
    ELSE NULL
  END AS is_draw
FROM Match m
views.description: One row per match with canonical match-level columns and basic derived flags (including a draw flag). Useful as the primary match cohort for season/date/team/score-based questions.

views.name: league_match_draw_counts
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  m.league_id AS league_id,
  COUNT(m.id) AS match_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN m.home_team_goal = m.away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS draw_match_count
FROM match_row_level m
GROUP BY m.league_id
views.description: Per-league aggregated counts of matches and draw matches for a specified cohort (can be filtered by season or date later). Exposes raw counts per league_id so final queries can filter and order as needed.
validated_on: Give the name of the league with the highest matches of all time and how many matches were played in the said league.

views.name: player_attribute_records
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  Player_Attributes.id AS id,
  Player_Attributes.player_api_id AS player_api_id,
  Player_Attributes.player_fifa_api_id AS player_fifa_api_id,
  Player_Attributes.date AS date,
  Player_Attributes.sprint_speed AS sprint_speed,
  Player_Attributes.overall_rating AS overall_rating,
  Player_Attributes.potential AS potential,
  Player_Attributes.preferred_foot AS preferred_foot
FROM Player_Attributes
views.description: Row-level Player_Attributes records (one row per Player_Attributes.id) with raw attribute measures and the record date. Useful as a cohort of attribute observations for filtering by date and attribute thresholds.

views.name: player_core
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  player_api_id,
  player_fifa_api_id,
  player_name,
  birthday,
  height,
  weight
FROM Player
WHERE birthday IS NOT NULL
views.description: Canonical Player rows with stable keys and normalized personal attributes (birthday, name). One row per player_api_id. Useful to join player identity and compute current age.

views.name: player_max_attribute_in_period
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.player_api_id AS player_api_id,
  MAX(pa.sprint_speed) AS max_sprint_speed,
  MAX(pa.overall_rating) AS max_overall_rating,
  COUNT(pa.id) AS observations_count,
  MIN(pa.date) AS min_date,
  MAX(pa.date) AS max_date
FROM Player p
LEFT JOIN Player_Attributes pa
  ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
GROUP BY p.player_api_id
views.description: Per-player aggregated maxima (and observation counts) of attribute measures within a selectable date window. Grain is one row per Player.player_api_id. Does not bake literal dates so it can be reused for different periods.

views.name: match_row_level_13
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  "id",
  "league_id",
  "date",
  "match_api_id",
  "home_team_api_id",
  "away_team_api_id"
FROM "Match"
views.description: One canonical row per Match record exposing keys needed for counting and joins to league and other dimensions. Normalizes/aliases important id and date columns but does not aggregate.

views.name: team_attributes_row
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  id,
  team_fifa_api_id,
  team_api_id,
  date,
  buildUpPlaySpeed,
  buildUpPlaySpeedClass,
  buildUpPlayPassing,
  buildUpPlayPassingClass,
  chanceCreationPassing,
  defencePressure,
  defenceAggression
FROM Team_Attributes
views.description: One row per Team_Attributes record with canonical numeric measures and key identifiers preserved. Cleans obvious nullable id and numeric fields (no aggregation).

views.name: team_attributes_by_team
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  team_api_id,
  team_fifa_api_id,
  COUNT(*) AS count_records,
  AVG(buildUpPlaySpeed) AS avg_buildUpPlaySpeed,
  MIN(buildUpPlaySpeed) AS min_buildUpPlaySpeed,
  MAX(buildUpPlaySpeed) AS max_buildUpPlaySpeed,
  AVG(buildUpPlayPassing) AS avg_buildUpPlayPassing,
  AVG(chanceCreationPassing) AS avg_chanceCreationPassing,
  AVG(defencePressure) AS avg_defencePressure
FROM Team_Attributes
GROUP BY team_api_id, team_fifa_api_id
views.description: Per team_api_id / team_fifa_api_id aggregate of Team_Attributes records (no temporal reduction): exposes min/max/avg of key numeric attributes so callers can filter teams by ranges or compute latest/typical values. Grouped at the team identifier level.

views.name: team_attributes_latest_per_team
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  ta.team_api_id AS team_api_id,
  ta.team_fifa_api_id AS team_fifa_api_id,
  ta.id AS id,
  ta.date AS date,
  ta.buildUpPlaySpeed AS buildUpPlaySpeed,
  ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass AS buildUpPlaySpeedClass,
  ta.buildUpPlayPassing AS buildUpPlayPassing,
  ta.chanceCreationPassing AS chanceCreationPassing,
  ta.defencePressure AS defencePressure
FROM Team_Attributes ta
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT team_api_id, MAX(date) AS max_date
  FROM Team_Attributes
  GROUP BY team_api_id
) latest ON ta.team_api_id = latest.team_api_id AND ta.date = latest.max_date
views.description: Latest Team_Attributes record per team_api_id (by date) to allow queries that need the most recent attribute snapshot per team. Keeps the full set of attribute columns from that latest row.

views.name: team_attributes_annual_rows
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  ta.id AS id,
  ta.team_api_id AS team_api_id,
  ta.date AS date,
  CAST(strftime('%Y', ta.date) AS INTEGER) AS year,
  ta.buildUpPlayPassing AS buildUpPlayPassing
FROM Team_Attributes ta
WHERE ta.buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL
views.description: One row per Team_Attributes record, normalized date-year plus raw numeric tactical measures. Keeps original team_api_id and buildUpPlayPassing (and other measures) for year-based cohorts.

views.name: team_api_to_team_long_name
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  team_api_id AS team_api_id,
  team_long_name AS team_long_name
FROM Team
views.description: Mapping of Team.team_api_id to its canonical team_long_name. Useful to resolve team names when joining team-level metrics to human-readable names.

views.name: team_yearly_max_attributes
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  team_api_id,
  strftime('%Y', date) AS year,
  MAX(buildUpPlayPassing) AS max_buildUpPlayPassing,
  COUNT(buildUpPlayPassing) AS observations_count,
  id
FROM Team_Attributes
WHERE buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY team_api_id, strftime('%Y', date)

semantic_filters.max_buildUpPlayPassing: derived from buildUpPlayPassing WHERE buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL

views.description: Per team_api_id and year, the maximum (or representative) buildUpPlayPassing observed that year and counts of non-null observations. Keeps raw measure (not averaged across teams) to support comparisons to cohort averages computed at query time.

views.name: player_preferred_foot_canonical
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  par.player_api_id AS player_api_id,
  par.player_fifa_api_id AS player_fifa_api_id,
  par.preferred_foot AS preferred_foot_raw,
  LOWER(par.preferred_foot) AS preferred_foot_canon,
  par.date AS attr_row_date
FROM Player_Attributes par
WHERE par.preferred_foot IS NOT NULL
views.description: One row per player_api_id + player_fifa_api_id capturing the canonical preferred_foot value (normalized to lowercase) and the latest attribute row date seen in Player_Attributes for that player. Keeps raw preferred_foot string for later exact comparisons and a canonicalized form.

views.name: player_basic_demographics
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.player_api_id,
  p.player_fifa_api_id,
  p.player_name,
  p.birthday,
  CAST(strftime('%Y', p.birthday) AS INTEGER) AS birth_year,
  CASE
    WHEN p.birthday IS NOT NULL
     AND length(strftime('%Y', p.birthday)) = 4
     AND strftime('%Y', p.birthday) NOT LIKE '0000'
    THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS birth_year_valid
FROM Player AS p
WHERE p.birthday IS NOT NULL
views.description: Canonical demographic info per player from Player table: player_api_id, player_fifa_api_id, player_name, and extracted birth_year (integer). Also includes a flag birth_year_valid indicating whether birthday parsed to a year.

views.name: player_cohort_with_foot_and_birthyear
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.player_api_id,
  p.player_fifa_api_id,
  p.player_name,
  pd.birth_year,
  pd.birth_year_valid,
  pp.preferred_foot_raw,
  pp.preferred_foot_canon,
  pp.attr_row_date
FROM Player AS p
JOIN player_basic_demographics AS pd
  ON pd.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
  AND pd.player_fifa_api_id = p.player_fifa_api_id
JOIN player_preferred_foot_canonical AS pp
  ON pp.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
  AND pp.player_fifa_api_id = p.player_fifa_api_id
WHERE pd.birth_year_valid = 1
views.description: Denormalized one-row-per-player combining demographics (birth_year) and canonical preferred_foot (from latest Player_Attributes). Intended as the reusable player cohort for queries that need a player's birth year and preferred foot, with deduplication to one row per player using latest attribute date.

views.name: player_attributes_rows
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  id,
  player_api_id,
  player_fifa_api_id,
  date,
  long_shots
FROM Player_Attributes
views.description: Row-level cohort of player attribute observations (one row per Player_Attributes.id) with raw attribute measures preserved and NULLs left as-is so callers can filter NULLs.

views.name: player_identity
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  pc.player_api_id AS player_api_id,
  pc.player_fifa_api_id AS player_fifa_api_id,
  pc.player_name AS player_name,
  pc.birthday AS birthday,
  pc.height AS height,
  pc.weight AS weight
FROM Player_core pc
views.description: Canonical player identity rows from Player table exposing stable keys and name/birthday/physical attributes to join against attribute observations.
validated_on: For the players who had a 77 points overall rating on 2016/6/23, who was the oldest? Give the name of the player.
What was the overall rating for Aaron Mooy on 2016/2/4?

views.name: player_attributes_with_player
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  pa.id AS id,
  pa.player_api_id AS player_api_id,
  pa.player_fifa_api_id AS player_fifa_api_id,
  pa.date AS date,
  pa.long_shots AS long_shots,
  p.player_name AS player_name
FROM Player_Attributes AS pa
LEFT JOIN Player AS p
  ON (pa.player_api_id IS NOT NULL AND p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id)
  OR (pa.player_api_id IS NULL AND pa.player_fifa_api_id IS NOT NULL AND p.player_fifa_api_id = pa.player_fifa_api_id)
views.description: Denormalized join of Player_Attributes rows to the canonical Player identity using either player_api_id or player_fifa_api_id; preserves one row per Player_Attributes.id and brings in player_name for filtering and reporting.

views.name: player_core_26
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.player_api_id AS player_api_id,
  p.player_fifa_api_id AS player_fifa_api_id,
  p.player_name AS player_name,
  p.birthday AS birthday,
  p.height AS height,
  p.weight AS weight
FROM Player p
WHERE p.player_api_id IS NOT NULL
  AND p.player_fifa_api_id IS NOT NULL
views.description: One canonical row per player with stable identifiers and demographic attributes (cleaned projection of Player). Useful as the player dimension for joins and height/biographic filters.

views.name: player_attribute_observations
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  pa.id AS id,
  pa.player_api_id AS player_api_id,
  pa.player_fifa_api_id AS player_fifa_api_id,
  pa.date AS date,
  pa.heading_accuracy AS heading_accuracy,
  pa.overall_rating AS overall_rating,
  pa.potential AS potential,
  pa.preferred_foot AS preferred_foot
FROM Player_Attributes pa
views.description: Row-level player attribute observations (one row per Player_Attributes record). Exposes raw attribute measures and the date of the observation, keeping player API/FIFA ids for joins. Excludes NULL heading_accuracy when a client requests heading-based analyses via question_ops, but by default returns all rows (view-level filter left empty for reuse).

views.name: player_heading_accuracy_avg
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  pa.player_api_id AS player_api_id,
  pa.player_fifa_api_id AS player_fifa_api_id,
  AVG(pa.heading_accuracy) AS avg_heading_accuracy,
  COUNT(pa.id) AS obs_count
FROM Player_Attributes pa
GROUP BY
  pa.player_api_id,
  pa.player_fifa_api_id
views.description: Average heading_accuracy per player (grouped by player identifiers). Aggregates raw Player_Attributes observations to a single measure per player to support ranking and filters like minimum observation counts or date windows.

views.name: league_match_goal_averages
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  m.league_id AS league_id,
  m.season AS season,
  AVG(CAST(m.home_team_goal AS REAL)) AS avg_home_goals,
  AVG(CAST(m.away_team_goal AS REAL)) AS avg_away_goals,
  COUNT(*) AS match_count
FROM match_row_level AS m
GROUP BY
  m.league_id,
  m.season
views.description: Per-league aggregated averages of home and away goals across matches. Aggregates are computed per league_id and season so consumers can filter by season and compare home vs away scoring rates.

views.name: player_core_30
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.player_api_id AS player_api_id,
  p.player_fifa_api_id AS player_fifa_api_id,
  p.player_name AS player_name,
  p.birthday AS birthday
FROM Player p
GROUP BY p.player_api_id, p.player_fifa_api_id, p.player_name, p.birthday
views.description: Canonical one-row-per-player projection with cleaned/canonical player identity and raw birthday preserved for date-based filters.

views.name: player_age_components
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.player_api_id,
  p.player_fifa_api_id,
  p.player_name,
  p.birthday,
  -- extract year, month, day from birthday text (assumes 'YYYY-MM-DD' or 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS')
  SUBSTR(p.birthday, 1, 4) AS birth_year,
  SUBSTR(p.birthday, 6, 2) AS birth_month,
  SUBSTR(p.birthday, 9, 2) AS birth_day
FROM Player p
views.description: Per-player decomposition of birthday into year, month, day components (text extraction) to support queries filtering or grouping by birth year/month/day.

views.name: player_attributes_with_player_32
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.player_name AS player_name,
  pa.date AS date,
  pa.overall_rating AS overall_rating,
  pa.player_api_id AS player_api_id,
  pa.player_fifa_api_id AS player_fifa_api_id,
  pa.id AS id
FROM Player_Attributes pa
LEFT JOIN Player p
  ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
     AND pa.player_fifa_api_id = p.player_fifa_api_id
views.description: Denormalized view joining Player_Attributes to Player to provide player name and identifiers alongside each attribute record. One row per Player_Attributes.id.
counter_examples: Calculate the average overall rating of Pietro Marino.

views.name: match_rows
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  m.id AS id,
  m.match_api_id AS match_api_id,
  m.season AS season,
  l.country_id AS country_id,
  m.home_team_api_id AS home_team_api_id,
  m.home_team_goal AS home_team_goal,
  m.date AS date
FROM matches_in_league_season m
LEFT JOIN league_basic l
  ON m.league_id = l.id
views.description: Base row-level Match records (one row per match). Exposes match identifiers, season, country linkage, and home-team scoring to support cohort filters and final aggregations.

views.name: country_lookup
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  Country.id AS id,
  Country.name AS name
FROM Country
views.description: Canonical Country rows exposing id and name for joins and human-readable filters.

views.name: match_with_country
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  m.id AS id,
  m.match_api_id AS match_api_id,
  m.season AS season,
  m.country_id AS country_id,
  c.name AS country_name,
  m.home_team_api_id AS home_team_api_id,
  m.home_team_goal AS home_team_goal,
  m.date AS date
FROM Match m
LEFT JOIN Country c
  ON m.country_id = c.id
views.description: Denormalized Match rows joined to Country name so queries can filter by country name directly while retaining one row per match.

views.name: player_basic
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.player_api_id AS player_api_id,
  p.player_name AS player_name,
  p.height AS height,
  p.player_fifa_api_id AS player_fifa_api_id,
  p.birthday AS birthday
FROM Player p
views.description: Canonical player rows with identifying keys and demographic attributes (one row per player). Useful as the player dimension for joins and for filtering by height, name, birthday, etc.

views.name: player_attribute_records_37
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  pa.id AS id,
  pa.player_api_id AS player_api_id,
  pa.player_fifa_api_id AS player_fifa_api_id,
  pa.date AS date,
  pa.overall_rating AS overall_rating,
  pa.potential AS potential,
  pa.finishing AS finishing
FROM Player_Attributes pa
WHERE pa.finishing IS NOT NULL
views.description: All player attribute measurement records (one row per Player_Attributes.id) exposing attribute values and the player key for joining. Keeps raw attribute measurements to allow computing averages, latest values, or other aggregations per player.

views.name: player_avg_finishing
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  player_api_id,
  AVG(finishing) AS avg_finishing,
  COUNT(finishing) AS num_finishing_rows
FROM
  Player_Attributes
GROUP BY
  player_api_id
HAVING
  COUNT(finishing) > 0
views.description: Average finishing per player_api_id computed from Player_Attributes (one row per player_api_id). Excludes players with no non-NULL finishing values. This view supplies the per-player measure needed for comparisons between cohorts (e.g., tallest vs shortest).

views.name: player_attributes_row_level
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  pa.id AS id,
  pa.player_api_id AS player_api_id,
  pa.player_fifa_api_id AS player_fifa_api_id,
  pa.date AS date,
  CAST(substr(pa.date,1,4) AS INTEGER) AS year,
  pa.overall_rating AS overall_rating
FROM Player_Attributes pa
WHERE pa.overall_rating IS NOT NULL
views.description: Row-level Player_Attributes records with canonicalized date year and non-null numeric ratings preserved. Keeps one row per Player_Attributes.id for use as a base cohort for time and rating filters.

views.name: player_attributes_with_player_40
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  pa.id AS id,
  pa.player_api_id AS player_api_id,
  pa.player_fifa_api_id AS player_fifa_api_id,
  pa.date AS date,
  CAST(strftime('%Y', pa.date) AS INTEGER) AS year,
  pa.overall_rating AS overall_rating,
  p.player_name AS player_name,
  p.height AS height,
  p.weight AS weight
FROM Player_Attributes pa
LEFT JOIN Player p
  ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE pa.overall_rating IS NOT NULL
views.description: Denormalized join of Player_Attributes rows to Player demographics. One row per Player_Attributes.id with player demographics attached to enable combined filters by date and height.

views.name: player_attributes_row
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  pa.id AS id,
  pa.player_api_id AS player_api_id,
  pa.date AS date,
  pa.ball_control AS ball_control,
  pa.overall_rating AS overall_rating,
  pa.potential AS potential,
  pa.preferred_foot AS preferred_foot
FROM Player_Attributes AS pa
views.description: One row per player-attribute observation (a single measurement of a player's attributes taken on a specific date). Exposes raw attribute columns for filtering and aggregation.

views.name: player_ball_control_avg
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  player_api_id,
  AVG(ball_control) AS avg_ball_control,
  COUNT(ball_control) AS num_ball_control_obs
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE ball_control IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY player_api_id
views.description: Average ball_control per player (computed from Player_Attributes rows). One row per player_api_id with the average computed across all non-NULL ball_control observations.

views.name: player_core_43
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  player_api_id,
  player_fifa_api_id,
  player_name,
  -- normalize birthday to ISO text (stored as TEXT already); keep as-is
  birthday,
  height,
  weight
FROM Player
views.description: Canonical row for each player with identity and demographic attributes (one row per player). Casts/normalizes birthday to text/ISO and exposes key id columns and name for filtering and joins.

views.name: player_attributes_by_date
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  pa.id AS id,
  pa.player_api_id AS player_api_id,
  pa.player_fifa_api_id AS player_fifa_api_id,
  pa.date AS date,
  pa.overall_rating AS overall_rating,
  pa.potential AS potential,
  pa.preferred_foot AS preferred_foot
FROM Player_Attributes pa
views.description: Player attributes observations over time (one row per Player_Attributes record). Exposes overall_rating, potential and attribute measures tied to a specific player_api_id and date to support temporal attribute lookups and joins to Player rows.

views.name: player_attributes_row_level_47
views.body_sql:
SELECT

views.name: player_attributes_categorical_projection
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  pa.id AS id,
  pa.player_api_id AS player_api_id,
  pa.date AS date,
  NULLIF(LOWER(TRIM(pa.preferred_foot)), '') AS preferred_foot_norm,
  NULLIF(LOWER(TRIM(pa.attacking_work_rate)), '') AS attacking_work_rate_norm,
  NULLIF(LOWER(TRIM(pa.defensive_work_rate)), '') AS defensive_work_rate_norm
FROM Player_Attributes pa
views.description: Normalized projection of Player_Attributes focusing on key categorical and identifier columns; casts empty strings to NULL and trims category text to canonical lowercase for stable filtering and reuse.

views.name: player_latest_attribute_per_player
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  pa.player_api_id AS player_api_id,
  pa.id AS "id AS player_attributes_id",
  pa.date AS date,
  pa.preferred_foot AS preferred_foot,
  pa.attacking_work_rate AS attacking_work_rate,
  pa.overall_rating AS overall_rating,
  pa.potential AS potential
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN (
  SELECT player_api_id, MAX(date) AS max_date
  FROM Player_Attributes
  WHERE player_api_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY player_api_id
) latest ON pa.player_api_id = latest.player_api_id AND pa.date = latest.max_date
views.description: Latest Player_Attributes record per player_api_id based on date. Useful for queries that need each player's most recent attributes (e.g., current preferred_foot or work rates).

views.name: player_basic_profile
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.player_api_id,
  p.player_fifa_api_id,
  p.player_name,
  p.birthday,
  CASE
    WHEN p.birthday IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN trim(p.birthday) = '' THEN NULL
    ELSE CAST(strftime('%Y', p.birthday) AS INTEGER)
  END AS birth_year,
  p.height,
  p.weight
FROM Player p
views.description: One row per player exposing stable player identifiers and canonicalized birth year plus basic physical attributes for filtering and joins.

views.name: player_with_attributes_join

  Player_Attributes.defensive_work_rate AS "Player_Attributes.defensive_work_rate",

LEFT JOIN Player
  ON Player_Attributes.player_api_id = Player.player_api_id
views.description: Denormalized view joining Player (canonical profile) with Player_Attributes observations to allow filtering by player demographics and attribute values together. One row per Player_Attributes.id (attribute observation) joined to that player's profile.

views.name: player_latest_attribute_on_date
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  pa_min.id AS id,
  pa_min.player_api_id AS player_api_id,
  DATE(pa_min.date) AS date,
  pa_min.overall_rating AS overall_rating,
  pa_min.potential AS potential
FROM Player_Attributes pa_min
JOIN (
  SELECT
    player_api_id,
    DATE(date) AS date_day,
    MAX(date) AS max_datetime
  FROM Player_Attributes
  GROUP BY player_api_id, DATE(date)
) latest
  ON pa_min.player_api_id = latest.player_api_id
  AND DATE(pa_min.date) = latest.date_day
  AND pa_min.date = latest.max_datetime
views.description: For each player and date (date truncated to day), pick the most recent Player_Attributes record on that date. Useful to resolve multiple snapshots on the same day before applying rating filters.
